name: 1 Samuel
lede: The ninth book of the Bible, in full: Hannah's son Samuel, the ark among the Philistines, Saul the first king, and David the shepherd, every word in the words of the ASV.

books.name: Hannah
books.blurb: Hannah in bitterness of soul at Shiloh, her vow, and Eli marking her mouth; Samuel born and lent to Jehovah — for this child I prayed; Hannah's song; the sons of Eli and the flesh-hook; the child Samuel in his linen ephod; and the man of God: them that honor me I will honor.

books.name: Speak, Jehovah
books.blurb: The lamp of God not yet gone out: Samuel, Samuel — speak; for thy servant heareth. The ark fetched from Shiloh and taken at Eben-ezer; Eli fallen by the gate; Ichabod, the glory is departed; Dagon fallen before the ark, and the ark carried about Ashdod, Gath and Ekron.

books.name: Give Us a King
books.blurb: The ark sent home on a new cart with golden tumors and mice, two milch kine lowing on the straight way to Beth-shemesh; Mizpah, the great thunder, and the stone Eben-ezer: hitherto hath Jehovah helped us. Then the elders at Ramah: make us a king to judge us like all the nations.

books.name: Saul Anointed
books.blurb: Kish's asses lost, and Saul, higher than any of the people, sent to seek them; the seer at the high place and the thigh reserved for him; the vial of oil; the band of prophets — is Saul also among the prophets?; the lot at Mizpah, Saul hid among the baggage, and long live the king.

books.name: To Obey Is Better
books.blurb: Nahash at Jabesh-gilead and Saul following the oxen out of the field; the kingdom renewed at Gilgal; Samuel's farewell — whose ox have I taken? — and thunder in wheat harvest; the Philistines as the sand at Michmash, Saul's burnt-offering, and a man after his own heart; no smith in all the land.

books.name: Jonathan at Michmash
books.blurb: Jonathan and his armorbearer climb between the crags Bozez and Seneh — there is no restraint to Jehovah to save by many or by few; the earth quaked; Saul's rash oath, the honey in the forest, the lot that took Jonathan, and the people who rescued him.

books.name: Jehovah Looketh on the Heart
books.blurb: Saul spares Agag and the best of Amalek's flocks: what meaneth this bleating of the sheep? To obey is better than sacrifice; the skirt rent and the kingdom rent from Saul. Then Samuel at Beth-lehem with his horn of oil, Jesse's sons passing by, the youngest fetched from the sheep, and David's harp before Saul.

books.name: Goliath
books.blurb: The vale of Elah and the champion of Gath, six cubits and a span, defying the armies of Israel forty days; a shepherd boy with parched grain and loaves; the lion and the bear; five smooth stones out of the brook; in the name of Jehovah of hosts — for the battle is Jehovah's.

books.name: Saul Hath Slain His Thousands
books.blurb: The soul of Jonathan knit with the soul of David; the women with timbrels: Saul hath slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands; the spear cast at the wall; Michal, the king's daughter; Michal lets David down through the window and lays the teraphim in his bed; and Saul among the prophets at Naioth.

books.name: Jonathan and David
books.blurb: There is but a step between me and death: the covenant with the house of David; the new moon and David's empty place; Saul's spear cast at Jonathan; three arrows by the stone Ezel; they kissed one another and wept. Then the holy bread and Goliath's sword at Nob, and David feigning madness at the gate of Gath.

books.name: The Cave
books.blurb: The cave of Adullam and the four hundred in distress; Doeg the Edomite and the priests of Nob; Keilah and the ephod; Jonathan in the wood of Ziph: thou shalt be king over Israel; this side and that side of the mountain in Maon; and the cave at En-gedi, where David cut off the skirt of Saul's robe and spared Jehovah's anointed.

books.name: Abigail
books.blurb: Samuel is dead; Nabal the churl railing at David's young men, and Abigail riding down with two hundred loaves — the soul of my lord shall be bound in the bundle of life; then the hill of Hachilah, Saul asleep with his spear stuck in the ground at his head, and David crying from the mountain top: behold the king's spear.

books.name: The Witch of En-dor
books.blurb: David a year and four months among the Philistines at Ziklag; Saul before the host at Shunem, Jehovah answering him not; the woman with a familiar spirit at En-dor by night, and an old man covered with a robe coming up out of the earth: to-morrow shalt thou and thy sons be with me; and David sent back from Aphek.
